subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having U?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd9d58eb6dcb741973b34d0688c68ba520fcc83a0e5383734a1cbc86cb636df2.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:- 

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners

From the positions 1, 2, 3 of Dice the opposite faces identified as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bba07d370297d61f35223a6e5bec059ce41b7437d1678a54ccef4f1070c218a.png] 

 
 

 **Alphabets**
 **Opposite side**
 
 

 **P**
 **U**
 
 

 S
 R
 
 

 Q
 Not shown (T)
 
 

 

∴ Here, the** opposite letter of U is 'P'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**
